shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\n-- files --\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' | sed -n '1,120p' && printf '\\n-- top-level project files --\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- package.json --' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '-- app/layout.tsx --' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '-- app/page.tsx --' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '-- app/ProductGrid.tsx --' && sed -n '1,300p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '-- app/ProductSkeleton.tsx --' && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '-- detail --' && sed -n '1,300p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '-- css --' && sed -n '1,360p' app/globals.css && printf '%s\\n' '-- products --' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts && printf '%s\\n' '-- next config --' && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n-- available eval files --\\n' && rg --files __agent_eval__ | sed -n '1,120p' && for file in __agent_eval__/*; do [ -f \""'$file" ] && { echo "-- $file --"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$file"; }; done'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json tsconfig.json && git diff --stat && git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed -n '1,80p' && find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\\n'"
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json && printf '\\n-- HEAD package --\\n' && git show HEAD:package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/globals.css
@@
   ::view-transition-old(*),
   ::view-transition-new(*),
   ::view-transition-group(*) {
-    animation-duration: 0.001ms "'!important;
+    animation-duration: 0s !important;
     animation-delay: 0s !important;
   }
 }
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    "lib": [
-      "dom",
-      "dom.iterable",
-      "esnext"
-    ],
+    "lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"],
@@
-    "paths": {
-      "@/*": [
-        "./*"
-      ]
-    }
+    "paths": {
+      "@/*": ["./*"]
+    }
   },
-  "include": [
-    "next-env.d.ts",
-    "**/*.ts",
-    "**/*.tsx",
-    ".next/types/**/*.ts",
-    ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"
-  ],
-  "exclude": [
-    "node_modules"
-  ]
+  "include": ["next-env.d.ts", "**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx", ".next/types/**/*.ts"],
+  "exclude": ["node_modules"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git status --short && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba next.config.ts && printf '\\n-- grid --\\n' && nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx && printf '\\n-- home --\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx && printf '\\n-- detail --\\n' && nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && printf '\\n-- css transition lines --\\n' && nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '1,290p'"
